purpose: Independent fixed application qualification tasks; source fixtures are inputs, never provider response fixtures. Each task starts from a fresh repository copy.

tasks.instruction: Make average([]) return 0; preserve nonempty means.
tasks.required_evidence: New empty-input regression fails before, passes after; existing checks pass.

tasks.instruction: Allow an optional greeting style. Ask whether formal means Welcome or Good day; implement the selected Welcome style and preserve existing greet calls.
tasks.required_evidence: Persist a decision, select it via API, and execute behavior checks against approved choice.

tasks.instruction: First change default greeting to Hello Steward, approve the reviewable patch, then request revision to Hello Team and rerun.
tasks.required_evidence: A new reviewable revision uses latest feedback, prior revision remains available, stale approval cannot apply.

tasks.instruction: Make default greeting Hello Steward while following approved knowledge: preserve explicit-name greetings and the public greet signature.
tasks.required_evidence: Knowledge version appears in exact run inputs; changed approved knowledge invalidates stale results.

tasks.instruction: Queue an average empty-input fix, cancel while actual provider or sandbox work is active, restart service, retry once.
tasks.required_evidence: Cancellation stops active work without publishing; restart leaves no orphan; retry yields one reviewable revision.

tasks.instruction: Review a seeded patch that replaces average with a constant 0 and removes the existing nonempty test. Do not label it verified safe.
tasks.required_evidence: Actual review rejects concrete wrong mean/test weakening and no verified-safe publication occurs.
